item.name: Reindeer Pet
item.obtainment: Hourly Event on the Event Board. The map turns into a Ginger Bread world, with a deer on a helicopter landing pad. You can ride this. Mini Reindeers walk up to a Brainrot and hit it, thus giving it the trait.
item.visuals: A Mini Reindeer accompanies the Brainrot.
item.notes: It is from an event that happens every so often.

item.name: Chocolate
item.obtainment: Admin Abuse. A pink and vibrant environment covers the map, a chocolate heart box appears above the Brainrot Spawn. Randomly applied to any spawned-in Brainrots.
item.visuals: A chocolate aura similar to Paint will be shown below the Brainrot, the Brainrot will appear to be covered in chocolate.
item.notes: This event was limited to a Seasonal Event related to Valentines Day.

item.obtainment: Admin Abuse. Randomly applied to any Brainrots.
item.visuals: Text that says "26" will appear on top of the Brainrot.
item.notes: This trait was used to celebrate New Years for 2026 and was activated on Taco Tuesday 2/24/2026 to celebrate Sammy's birthday, but it might NEVER be activated ever again...

item.name: Halo
item.obtainment: Divine Event. The map is designed in elegant and heavenly embroidery, distinguishable symbols can be found. Randomly applied to Brainrots that have the Divine Mutation.
item.visuals: A visible halo appears above the Brainrots head.
item.notes: Only available during the Divine Event.

item.name: Lucky
item.obtainment: Lucky Pot. No notable environment changes. Randomly applied to any Brainrots.
item.visuals: A green overlay appears over the Brainrot, with coins coming out from it.
item.notes: Part of a Seasonal Event.

item.name: Jack O'Lantern Pet
item.obtainment: Spawns during an hourly rotation of Halloween Events. A rollercoaster goes around the map, with houses place between bases. Randomly applied to any brainrots walking on the map.
item.visuals: An orange pumpkin with green neon lights illuminating inside of it.
item.notes: The Event Board was removed on November 2, 2025 at 11:00AM EST.

item.name: Bunny Ears
item.obtainment: Easter Hour Bunny's appear around the map. Randomly applied to any brainrots walking on the map.
item.visuals: Bunny ears appear on top of the Brainrots head.

item.name: Santa Hat
item.obtainment: Similarly to the Witching Hour, a Christmas Sammy will be at the side every Winter Hour. There is snow everywhere and a Christmas Sammy resides near the red carpet. At the beginning of this event, a Christmas Brainrot spawns. (Please add more detail) Sammy, dressed in a Festive costume, goes to a random brainrot on the red carpet. Once this happens, the brainrot gets this trait.
item.visuals: A Santa Hat appears on top of the Brainrots head(s).
item.notes: It is from an event that happens every so often.

item.name: RIP Tombstone
item.obtainment: Spawns during an hourly rotation of Halloween Events. A dark and veiny environment appears, with graves in the surroundings. Randomly applied to any brainrots walking on the map.
item.visuals: A Tombstone appears on top of the specified Brainrot.
item.notes: The Event Board was removed on November 2, 2025 at 11:00AM EST.

item.name: Witching Hour
item.obtainment: Spawns during an hourly rotation of Halloween Events. A purple environment appears, with pumpkins in the surroundings. Randomly applied to brainrots on the red carpet (possibly obtainable if it is anywhere on the map)
item.visuals: A Witch hat appears on top of the Brainrots head(s).
item.notes: The Event Board was removed on November 2, 2025 at 11:00AM EST.

item.name: Skeleton
item.obtainment: Spawned every two hours during the Extinct Event. A dried out environment covered with fossils. Randomly applied to any spawned-in Brainrots.
item.visuals: Ribs comes out of the Brainrots chest.
item.notes: The Extinct Event used to occur every hour or so, but is now removed.

item.name: 10B
item.obtainment: Admin Abuse. The map will be lined up with firework launchers which will shoot rainbow fireworks. Randomly applied to any Brainrots hit by a firework.
item.visuals: Text that says "10B" will appear on top of the Brainrot.
item.notes: This trait was used to celebrate Steal a Brainrot's 10B visit milestone, and has NEVER been activated again since that milestone.

item.name: Paint
item.obtainment: Chicleteira Bicicleteira ritual / Admin Abuse. The Red Carpet is designed to look like a highway. Randomly applied to any Brainrots on the Red Carpet.
item.visuals: A graffiti aura appears under the Brainrot.
item.notes: If done with the ritual, a Los Chicleteiras(Link) spawns.

item.obtainment: Admin Abuse. A playful environment amasses the map, leaving cats from Los Mi Gatitos roaming around. Randomly applied to Brainrots that are currently spawned in.
item.visuals: The Brainrot will have a speech bubble with ":3" appear on their right side.
item.notes: This trait was released with Mi Gatito, only ever being spawned three times.

item.name: Tie
item.obtainment: Dul Dul Dul ritual / Admin Abuse. A graduation platform appears at the beginning of the Red Carpet, along with a Brainrot School in the background. Randomly applied to any Brainrots that step on the graduation platform.
item.visuals: A tie appears, depending on the Brainrot.
item.notes: If done with the ritual, a Yess my examine(Link) or Noo my examine(Link) spawns.

item.name: Spider
item.obtainment: Sammyni Spyderini ritual / Admin Abuse. A giant cobweb spawns on the ground and spreads across the map, along with Spiders roaming around. Randomly applied to any spawned-in Brainrots.
item.visuals: A spider covers the right eye of the Brainrot.
item.notes: If done with the ritual, a Los Spyderinis(Link) spawns.

item.name: Matteo Hat
item.obtainment: Matteo ritual / Admin Abuse. A tree sprouts from the middle of the Red Carpet, followed by lightning. Randomly applied to any Brainrots that walk into the tree or by being struck by lightning.
item.visuals: A bowler hat, or Matteo's Hat, appears on the Brainrots head(s).
item.notes: If done with the ritual, a Los Matteos(Link) spawns.

item.name: Galactic
item.obtainment: La Vacca Saturno Saturnita ritual / Admin Abuse. The sky become galaxy like, shooting down comets. Randomly applied to any Brainrots that are struck by a comet.
item.visuals: A purple aura is added onto the Brainrot.
item.notes: If done with the ritual, a Las Vaquitas Saturnitas(Link) spawns.

item.name: Explosive
item.obtainment: Bombardiro Crocodilo ritual / Admin Abuse. A dark sky is overshadowed by multiple Bombardiro Crocodilo's flying in the sky, dropping Svinina Bombardino's. Randomly applied to any Brainrots that are struck by a Svinina Bombardino.
item.visuals: A explosion aura is applied onto the Brainrot.
item.notes: If done with the ritual, a Los Crocodillitos(Link) spawns.

item.name: Shark Fin
item.obtainment: Orcalero Orcala ritual / Admin Abuse. The map swalloed in water, having Orcalero Orcala's and Tralalero Tralala's swimming around. Randomly applied to any Brainrots that are hit by Orcalero Orcala or Tralalero Tralala.
item.visuals: A shark fin is applied onto the Brainrots back.
item.notes: If done with the ritual, a Los Orcalitos(Link) spawns.

item.name: Brazil
item.obtainment: Admin Abuse. The screen will go dark and then clear after the map adds favelas, along with a giant speaker behind the Brainrots spawn. Randomly applied to any Brainrots that are struck by the laser beams.
item.visuals: A Brazillian Flag particle effect is added onto the Brainrot.
item.notes: Plays the song below. https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:BrazilianConcertSlowed.mp3 When will Brazil's cube apply the trait to brainrot: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Cube_riser.mp3 When Brazil's cube applies the trait to the brainrot: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Cube_aplies.mp3

item.name: Indonesia
item.obtainment: Admin Abuse. The map will turn into an Indonesian city. An 'Aura Boat' spawns shortly after the event starts. Randomly applied to any spawned-in Brainrots.
item.visuals: An Indonesian Flag pulses in the center of the Brainrot, which is usually covered by the Brainrot itself.
item.notes: Plays the songs below. https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:IndonesiaEventLoop1.mp3 https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:IndonesiaEventLoop2.mp3

item.name: Sombrero
item.obtainment: Admin Abuse. The map will have Hacienda styled building on the sides, along with a Pinata that spawns in the middle. Cockroaches can be seen roaming around. Randomly applied to any spawned-in Brainrots.
item.visuals: A Sombrero will appear on top of the Brainrots head(s).
item.notes: Plays the songs below. https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Mexicomusic.mp3 When the cockroach puts the hat on the brainrot/player: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Sombrero_sound.mp3

item.name: Granny
item.obtainment: Admin Abuse. The map turns into church visionaries, having a resting place for Granny by the Brainrot spawn. Randomly applied to any Brainrots spawned in.
item.visuals: Granny is visible to the right of the Brainrot.
item.notes: This event was only obtainable during 21/3/2026 - 22/3/2026.

item.name: Fire
item.obtainment: Admin Abuse. A sun appears above the map and shoots out solar flares that move along the map. Randomly applied to any Brainrots that are struck by the solar flare.
item.visuals: The Brainrot will appear to be burning, as multiple bursts of fire occur on the Brainrot.
item.notes: The solar flares can also hit players, ragdolling them. This may be a refrence to the fire visual effect in the original Italian Brainrot memes.

item.name: Rose
item.obtainment: Admin Abuse. A concert like area with cool looks. Randomly applied to any Brainrots that are hit by a falling rose.
item.visuals: The Brainrot will appear to have little roses around them.
item.notes: This trait isn't obtainable anymore.

item.name: Fireworks
item.obtainment: Admin Abuse. The map is lined with firework launchers that shoot fireworks. Randomly applied to any Brainrots that are struck by fireworks.
item.visuals: A firework particle effect will be applied to the Brainrot.
item.notes: Introduced for Independence Day in the USA. Doesn't show up often during Admin Abuse's. Firework launcher shoots a firework: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Firework_Shot.mp3 Fireworks exploding: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Firework_explodes.mp3 Firework applying trait to brainrot: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Firework_hit.mp3

item.name: Nyan
item.obtainment: Admin Abuse. The map will be circled by a plethora of Nyan Cats. Randomly applied to any spawned-in Brainrots.
item.visuals: A rainbow trail will be added onto the Brainrot.
item.notes: Plays the song below. https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:NyanLoop.mp3 Nyan cat hitting a brainrot: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Nyan_Cat_Hit_2.mp3

item.name: Lightning
item.obtainment: Admin Abuse. The sky turns galaxy-themed with mygame43 behind the Brainrot Spawn. Randomly applied to Brainrots struck by lightning.
item.visuals: A dragon will be beside the Brainrot or on their right shoulder.
item.notes: This event has a BloxFruit creator in it.

item.name: Disco
item.obtainment: Admin Abuse. The screen goes dark with neon lights and music turning on shortly after. DJs Tralalero Tralala(Link) and Chimpanzini Bananini(Link) will appear behind the Brainrot Spawn. Randomly applied to any spawned-in Brainrots.
item.visuals: A glowing aura will appear on the Brainrot.
item.notes: This event used to feature Tung Tung Tung Sahur(Link) behind the Brainrot Spawn.

item.name: Glitched
item.obtainment: Admin Abuse. The sky turns dark and the map will appear glitchy. Randomly applied to Brainrots on the Red Carpet.
item.visuals: A glitchy aura will be added onto the Brainrot.
item.notes: This event was recently updated for the 1x1x1x1 Ritual Event.

item.name: Crab Claw
item.obtainment: Admin Abuse. A seashore will be visible with water being on the sides of the Red Carpet, Crab Rave will play with crabs dancing. Crabs will occasionally pinch players. Randomly applied to Brainrots pinched by the crabs.
item.visuals: Crab arms will be added onto the Brainrot.
item.notes: Plays the song below. https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:CrabRave.mp3

item.name: Zombie
item.obtainment: Admin Abuse. Evil Los Tung Tung's will come out of the caves to attack players. A huge Tung Tung Tung Sahur(Link) will appear behind the Brainrot Spawn. Randomly applied to Brainrots struck by the Evil Tung Tung's.
item.visuals: Glowing red eyes will be added onto the Brainrot.
item.notes: The event returned on November 29, the evil tung tungs can rarely go after players to knock them to the ground. The sound the Tung Tung Tung sahurs make: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:TungEffect3_1.mp3

item.name: Bubblegum
item.obtainment: Admin Abuse. A bubblegum machine will spawn in front of the Brainrot Spawn. Randomly applied to Brainrots in the Bubblegum Machine.
item.visuals: A bubblegum bubble will appear on their head.
item.notes: Previously an Event, it was activated by putting 10 Candy Brainrots inside the Bubblegum Machine.

item.name: UFO
item.obtainment: Admin Abuse. The sky turns galaxy-themed and UFO's will appear. Randomly applied to Brainrots hit by the UFO's beam.
item.visuals: A mini UFO will appear above the Brainrots head.
item.notes: Plays the song below. https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:AlienLoop.mp3

item.name: Taco
item.obtainment: Admin Abuse. Tacos start falling out of the sky and a cannon will appear above the Brainrot Spawn. Randomly applied to Brainrots hit by the Taco Cannon.
item.visuals: A Taco will appear on the Brainrots head(s).
item.notes: Added for Sammy's love of tacos, it's guaranteed to happen every Taco Tuesday. Cannon shooting a taco: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Taco_Cannon_Shot.mp3 Taco hitting a brainrot: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Taco_Cannon_Hit.mp3

item.name: Sleepy
item.obtainment: Admin Abuse. Beanstalks appear scattered across the map and a skull emoji will appear. "YOU FELL ASLEEP" will also pop up. Brainrots will become sleepy.
item.visuals: Z's appear coming from the top and start vanishing off from the left of the Brainrot.
item.notes: The worst trait in the game as it decreases Brainrot values by half. Sleepy Burst: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:SleepyBurst.mp3

item.name: Comet-struck
item.obtainment: Randomized. Stars will begin to fall out the sky. Randomly applied to Brainrots hit by the star fall.
item.visuals: A Comet-struck aura of yellow and blue sparks will be added to Brainrots.
item.notes: A natural event commonly confused in the Community Server as a 'Admin Event.'

item.name: Snowy
item.obtainment: Randomized. Piles of snow are visible on the now white grass. Snow can visibly be seen falling from the sky. Randomly applied to any spawned-in Brainrots.
item.visuals: Snowflakes will be added to the Brainrot.
item.notes: Plays the song below. https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:SnowLoop.mp3

item.name: Wet
item.obtainment: ' The sky turns cloudy and rain starts to pour; It begins to rain. There is a myth that rain is activated if it's raining where Sammy is at the moment. Randomly applied to any spawned-in Brainrots.
item.visuals: Water droplets will be applied to the Brainrot.
item.notes: The game time turns rainy and raindrops fall all over the map. The ambient sound of the map when it's raining: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Rain_ambience_sound_loop.mp3 When the brainrot gets the trait: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Rain_burst.mp3
